SELECT SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 AS OriProjectNO, SORDERP.SALFCY_0 AS OrderSite, SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 AS OrderLine, SORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS OrderDate, SORDERQ.QTY_0 AS ProjectQty,
COMPANY.ACCCUR_0 AS Currency, ROUND( SORDERP.NETPRI_0 * SORDERQ.QTY_0 * SORDER.CHGRAT_0, 2 ) AS SalesAmount, ROUND( SORDERP.NETPRI_0 * SORDERQ.QTY_0 * SORDER.CHGRAT_0 * SORDER.ORDATI_0 / NULLIF(SORDER.ORDNOT_0, 0), 2 ) AS SalesAmountWithTax, IIF (SORDERQ.SOQSTA_0 = 3, 'Closed', 'Open') AS OrderStatus FROM EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 = SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.COMPANY COMPANY ON COMPANY.MAIFCY_0 = SORDER.SALFCY_0
WHERE SORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0

-- The sales order SELECT SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 AS OriProjectNO, SORDERP.SALFCY_0 AS OrderSite, T_PN.PN AS PN, SORDERQ.QTY_0 AS ProjectQty, SORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS OrderDate, SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 AS OrderLine, IIF (SORDERQ.SOQSTA_0 = 3, 'Closed', 'Open') AS OrderStatus, COMPANY.ACCCUR_0 AS Currency, ROUND( SORDERP.NETPRI_0 * SORDERQ.QTY_0 * SORDER.CHGRAT_0, 2 ) AS SalesAmount, ROUND( SORDERP.NETPRI_0 * SORDERQ.QTY_0 * SORDER.CHGRAT_0 * SORDER.ORDATI_0 / NULLIF(SORDER.ORDNOT_0, 0), 2 ) AS SalesAmountWithTax FROM ( ) AS T_PN INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP ON T_PN.PN = SORDERP.ITMREF_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 = SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.COMPANY COMPANY ON COMPANY.MAIFCY_0 = SORDER.SALFCY_0 WHERE SORDERP.NETPRI_0 > 0
ORDER BY SORDER.ORDDAT_0 DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

-- The provided projectNO and Qty for closed sales order -- The provided projectNO maybe from other project / stock project SELECT DISTINCT T00.OrderSite, T00.OrderNO, T00.OrderLine, CASE WHEN LEN (STOJOU.LOT_0) > 5 THEN STOJOU.LOT_0 WHEN LEN (STOJOU.SERNUM_0) > 4 THEN LEFT (STOJOU.SERNUM_0, LEN (STOJOU.SERNUM_0) -4) ELSE NULL END AS ProvideProjectNO, COUNT(STOJOU.SERNUM_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, T00.ProjectNO, STOJOU.LOT_0 ) AS ProvideQty FROM T00 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.STOJOU STOJOU ON STOJOU.STOFCY_0 = T00.OrderSite AND STOJOU.VCRTYP_0 = 4 -- 4: delivery do not delete, index required, otherwise performance issue AND STOJOU.VCRNUMORI_0 = T00.OrderNO AND STOJOU.VCRLINORI_0 = T00.OrderLine WHERE T00.OrderStatus = 'Closed'

-- The provided projectNO and total Qty for closed sales order -- The provided projectNO maybe from other project / stock project SELECT DISTINCT src.OrderSite, src.ProvideProjectNO, SUM(src.QTYSTU_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY src.OrderSite, src.ProvideProjectNO ) AS ProvideTotalQty FROM ( -- 分支1:精确匹配 SELECT T01.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO, PORDERQ.QTYSTU_0 FROM T01 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.OPPOR OPPOR ON T01.ProvideProjectNO = OPPOR.OPPNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP PORDERP ON T01.OrderSite = PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 AND OPPOR.OPPNUM_0 = PORDERP.PJT_0 AND PORDERP.ITMREF_0 = OPPOR.OPPEXTNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ AS PORDERQ ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERP.POPLIN_0 = PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 WHERE PORDERQ.LINAMT_0 > 0 UNION ALL -- 分支2:文本包含匹配 SELECT T01.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO, PORDERQ.QTYSTU_0 FROM T01 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.OPPOR OPPOR ON T01.ProvideProjectNO = OPPOR.OPPNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP PORDERP ON T01.OrderSite = PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 AND OPPOR.OPPNUM_0 = PORDERP.PJT_0 AND CHARINDEX (OPPOR.OPPEXTNUM_0, PORDERP.ITMDES1_0) > 0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ AS PORDERQ ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERP.POPLIN_0 = PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 WHERE PORDERQ.LINAMT_0 > 0 ) src

-- T00: sales order -- T01: The provided projectNO and Qty for closed sales order -- T02: The provided projectNO and total Qty for closed sales order WITH T00 AS ( -- wrap it to allow pagination in CTE SELECT * FROM ( ) AS T ), T01 AS ( ), T02 AS ( ), T03 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT T00.*,
T01.ProvideProjectNO, T01.ProvideQty, PORDERP.PJT_0 AS PurchaseProjectNO, PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AS PurchaseNO, PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 AS PurchaseLine, PORDERQ.ITMREF_0 AS PurchasePN, PORDERP.ITMDES1_0 AS Description, PORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS PurchaseDate, PORDER.BPSNUM_0 AS SupplierCode, BPSUPPLIER.BPSSHO_0 AS SupplierName, PORDERQ.QTYSTU_0 AS PurchaseQty, PORDERQ.STU_0 AS Unit, PORDERQ.NETCUR_0 AS LineCurrency, PORDERP.NETPRI_0 AS LineNetPrice, PORDERQ.LINAMT_0 AS LineAmount, PORDERQ.LINATI_0 AS LineAmountWithTax,
ROUND( T01.ProvideQty / T02.ProvideTotalQty / T00.ProjectQty * SUM(PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY T01.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO ), 2 ) AS Cost, ROUND( T01.ProvideQty / T02.ProvideTotalQty / T00.ProjectQty * SUM( PORDERQ.LINATI_0 / NULLIF(PORDERQ.LINAMT_0, 0) * PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0 ) OVER ( PARTITION BY T01.OrderSite, T01.ProvideProjectNO ), 2 ) AS CostWithTax
FROM T00 INNER JOIN T01 ON T00.OrderNO = T01.OrderNO AND T00.OrderLine = T01.OrderLine INNER JOIN T02 ON T02.OrderSite = T01.OrderSite AND T02.ProvideProjectNO = T01.ProvideProjectNO INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP AS PORDERP ON T01.ProvideProjectNO = PORDERP.PJT_0 AND T01.OrderSite = PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ AS PORDERQ ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERP.POPLIN_0 = PORDERQ.POPLIN_0
INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDER AS PORDER ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDER.POHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.BPSUPPLIER BPSUPPLIER ON BPSUPPLIER.BPSNUM_0 = PORDER.BPSNUM_0
WHERE PORDERQ.LINAMT_0 > 0 ), T10 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT T00.*,
'' AS ProvideProjectNO, '' AS ProvideQty, PORDERP.PJT_0 AS PurchaseProjectNO, PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AS PurchaseNO, PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 AS PurchaseLine, PORDERQ.ITMREF_0 AS PurchasePN, PORDERP.ITMDES1_0 AS Description, PORDER.ORDDAT_0 AS PurchaseDate, PORDER.BPSNUM_0 AS SupplierCode, BPSUPPLIER.BPSSHO_0 AS SupplierName, PORDERQ.QTYSTU_0 AS PurchaseQty, PORDERQ.STU_0 AS Unit, PORDERQ.NETCUR_0 AS LineCurrency, PORDERP.NETPRI_0 AS LineNetPrice, PORDERQ.LINAMT_0 AS LineAmount, PORDERQ.LINATI_0 AS LineAmountWithTax,
ROUND( SUM(PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, T00.ProjectNO ), 2 ) AS Cost, ROUND( SUM( PORDERQ.LINAMTCPR_0 * PORDERQ.LINATI_0 / NULLIF(PORDERQ.LINAMT_0, 0) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY T00.OrderSite, T00.ProjectNO ), 2 ) AS CostWithTax
FROM T00 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERP AS PORDERP ON ( T00.ProjectNO = PORDERP.PJT_0 OR ( T00.OriProjectNO = PORDERP.PJT_0 AND LEN (T00.OriProjectNO) > 5 ) -- exclude T0001 cross site project ) AND T00.OrderSite = PORDERP.PRHFCY_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDERQ AS PORDERQ ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDERQ.POHNUM_0 AND PORDERP.POPLIN_0 = PORDERQ.POPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.PORDER AS PORDER ON PORDERP.POHNUM_0 = PORDER.POHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.BPSUPPLIER BPSUPPLIER ON BPSUPPLIER.BPSNUM_0 = PORDER.BPSNUM_0 WHERE PORDERQ.LINAMT_0 > 0 AND T00.OrderStatus = 'Open' --- Only include open orders ) SELECT *, T03.SalesAmount - T03.Cost AS Profit, T03.SalesAmountWithTax - T03.CostWithTax AS ProfitWithTax, T03.SalesAmount / NULLIF(T03.Cost, 0) AS ProfitRate FROM T03 UNION ALL SELECT *, T10.SalesAmount - T10.Cost AS Profit, T10.SalesAmountWithTax - T10.CostWithTax AS ProfitWithTax, T10.SalesAmount / NULLIF(T10.Cost, 0) AS ProfitRate FROM T10 ORDER BY OrderSite DESC, OrderDate DESC, ProjectNO DESC
, LineAmountWithTax DESC -- Let the biggest cost be the first line
